items.t: Said he applauds the Greene County sheriff for working with ICE.
items.q: I applaud the Greene County sheriff for working with ICE to make that we don't have illegals on our roads, illegals out here committing crimes and things of that nature

items.t: Said that a lawsuit blocking federal access to commercial-driver records sides with foreigners driving 18-wheelers who could harm citizens because they are not qualified.
items.q: Once again, we're siding with illegals or foreigners who are here driving 18-wheelers… who could harm our citizens because they're not qualified,

items.t: Said Virginia's Democratic leadership does not want to cooperate with President Trump in any area.
items.q: they are so mad at Trump, they want to make sure they don't want to cooperate with Trump in any area whatsoever, and they want make it unsafe for Virginians,

record.t: Was chief co-patron of HB 1514, which would establish the Virginia Sports and Entertainment Authority and passed the House of Delegates 59 to 40.
record.q: The bill earned bipartisan support, sponsored by chief patron Del. Luke Torian (Prince William) and chief co-patron Del. Terry Kilgore (Scott County), and passed with a vote of 59 to 40.
